1.en_consolidated_definition:
To relax.

Relax oneself or become less tense.

To calm down or become more tranquil.

To release physical or mental tension.

To unwind or take it easy.

Note: In some contexts, this term may also imply a sense of letting go or surrendering to a situation, similar to the concept of "darle vuelo" in Puerto Rican culture.
